title: NIH RePORTER Biomedical Grant Awards & Lab Funding Scraper
desc: Scrape official NIH RePORTER v2 API for biomedical research grants, award amounts, project abstracts, funded institutions, and principal investigators. Keyless official REST API with pagination slicing.

title: NIH RePORTER Funded Projects - Awards, PIs and Organizations
desc: Search awarded NIH grants from the official RePORTER Project API. No API key. Returns project number, title, PI, organization, award amount and dates. One charge per funded project. This is awarded funding, not open Grants.gov opportunities.

title: ClinicalTrials.gov PI Emails + NIH Grant & CRO Signals
desc: 🔗 [Multi-Source Cross-Joined] Extract recruiting clinical trials from ClinicalTrials.gov v2 + Cross-Join NIH RePORTER grant funding ($) + Harvest ALL multi-center PI direct emails/phones + Compute CRO Patient Recruitment Bottleneck & Site Burden scores.

title: NIH Grant Winners + Verified PI Emails (NSF & PubMed Join)
desc: 🔗 [Entity-Pure Relational LEFT JOIN: NIH RePORTER × NSF Awards × Europe PMC Author Affiliations] 1 Row = 1 NIH Grant Lab enriched with that exact PI's cross-agency NSF funding ($), verified .edu email, phone, budget burn urgency, and inferred equipment spend tags.

title: NIH & NSF Research Grant Awards Feed (new awards, daily)
desc: New NIH and NSF research grant awards in one feed: institution, amount, title, abstract, funding institute, award type and dates. Filter by keyword, institution, state or amount. 'New since last run' mode for lab-supply, CRO and research-sales lead alerts.

title: PubMed Scraper: Abstracts, Authors, MeSH, DOIs, Citations
desc: Search PubMed through the official NCBI E-utilities API or look up PMIDs, PMCIDs and DOIs. Get titles, abstracts, authors, affiliations, journals, MeSH terms, DOIs, PMC links and NIH iCite citation counts. No login. Failed or empty inputs are free.

title: Grants Search — Grants.gov, NIH, NSF & EU Funding Calls
desc: Open grant opportunities and funded projects in one table: Grants.gov forecasts and open calls, EU Funding & Tenders calls, NIH RePORTER and NSF awards. Deadline, award ceiling/floor, eligibility, CFDA, funder, link. For grant writers, nonprofits, startups, universities. $1 per 1,000 results.
